examples.explanation: Keep 'a' at 0, 'b' at 2 and 'c' at 5 of t.
After matching 'a', no 'x' appears later in t.
Erasing everything leaves the empty string.

hints: Walk through t once while advancing a pointer into s on matches.
If the s-pointer reaches the end, every character was found in order.
This greedy scan is optimal because taking the earliest match never hurts.
title: 468. Is Subsequence
